text: oh yeah that is a lot better haha ok ok hey what about i was thinking, so we have that svg to neon light prop convert, maybe u could do svg paths that turn into the tree trunks. eitherway. these are nice. [Image #7] way better than the last sets of black n mild trunks lmao
resolution: Realized the SVG-path-to-trunk idea: a PathTube geometry sweeps a tapered round tube along a spine polyline, fed by the neon prop's flattenPathD (the canonical SVG-d-to-polyline parser, exported now; already mirrored compiled-side in decal_raster.zig parsePath) so trunks reuse the SAME path geometry, no second parser. A trunk is authorable as a drawn curve and generalizes to branches (multi-subpath SVG). The probe's left tree renders a drawn S-leaning PathTube trunk; the user confirmed the curve reads much better than the parametric PalmTrunk, so this is the trunk approach going forward. Verified via self-shot.
